You didn't say where at the conference you spoke, so the email names only the topic. Add the spot if you remember it, such as a table or a session.
You didn't say when the conference was, so I left out any time reference. Today is Oct 13, so check that the conference was recent enough for this follow-up to make sense.
I wrote that Marcus suggested writing because the consumer team runs the sophomore program and hires from it. Make sure that matches what he told you.

scenarios.preReviewSubject: Following Up from the SEO Career Summit in New York
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Olivia,

It was great to meet you at the SEO Career Summit in New York. We talked about the grocery chain turnaround you worked on, and what stuck with me is that consumer deals come down to repeat customers. That idea is a big part of why consumer and retail M&A draws me.

My name is Maya Okafor, an Atlanta native and a sophomore studying Economics at Duke University, graduating in 2029. This summer I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks as an intern at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, and I'm a consumer sector analyst in the Duke Investment Club.

Marcus Delacroix suggested I write to you, since the consumer team runs the sophomore program and hires from it. First, when does the sophomore program open? Second, does it feed into the summer analyst class?

My resume is attached in case it helps put my background in context. Thank you for your time!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
maya.okafor@duke.edu
(919) 555-0142

notesForStudent: I didn't name the three brands because you didn't list them. You could add them in the second sentence if you like.
Your notes say you want to talk through what you've seen in the brands. I turned that into the reason for the call. Change it if you have something else in mind.
The application deadline is October 15. Please check the date you plan to send this, since it may be very close.
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Rachel,

When we spoke in March, you told me to start tracking a few consumer brands closely. I did, and I'm now following three of them. It sits well alongside my work as a consumer sector analyst in Duke Investment Club, and with the dividend stock screening model I built at Pinecrest Wealth Partners this summer.

Thank you for sending me to Ben Ortega. He walked me through how the consumer team decides which deals sophomores staff, which I wouldn't have known to ask about.

The summer analyst application closes October 15. Would you have 15 minutes before then? I'd like to talk through what I've been seeing in the three brands and hear where you'd push me next.

Any time that suits you before the deadline works on my end. Thank you, Rachel!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29

(919) 555-0142
